OFFICE OF THE DISTRICT MEDICAL AND HEALTH OFFICER, HANUMAKONDA
NOTIFICATION NO. 02 / 2026 , Date: 08-10-2026.
Applications are invited for Various Category of Posts under the control of
District Medical and Health Officer, Hanumakonda District on contract / outsourcing
basis under National Health Mission (NHM)
The application may be downloaded from the official website of the
https://hanumakonda.telangana.gov.in Hanumakonda District. from 08-10-2026 to
15-10-2026 till 5.00 P.M.
The downloaded Application shall be filled in by the Candidates, duly enclosed
the required copies of certificates and shall be submitted (offline) in IDOC,2nd Floor,
S-16, O/o. DM&HO, Hanumakonda District. Last date for submission of Application is
15-10-2026, till 5.00 P.M.
Note: Candidates are advised not to believe or rely on any false or misleading
information regarding the recruitment process and not to pay money to anyone for securing
employment. The selection of candidates will be made strictly on the basis of merit and as
per the prescribed recruitment guidelines. In case of any queries or clarifications,
candidates may contact the Administrative Officer or Office Superintendent, O/o the
DM&HO, Hanumakonda District.
Sd/-
